scripts.ui:dev:isolated: OP_HOME=$(pwd)/.dev PORT=3880 OP_HOST_UI_PORT=3880 bun run --cwd packages/ui dev -- --port 3880
scripts.electron:dev: bun run ui:build && bun run --cwd packages/electron bundle && OP_HOME=/tmp/openpalm-electron-dev OPENPALM_REPO_ROOT="$PWD" bun run --cwd packages/electron start
scripts.electron:dev:fast: bun run --cwd packages/electron bundle && OP_HOME=/tmp/openpalm-electron-dev OPENPALM_REPO_ROOT="$PWD" bun run --cwd packages/electron start
scripts.ui:test:e2e: source scripts/load-test-env.sh && cd packages/ui && RUN_DOCKER_STACK_TESTS=1 PW_ENFORCE_NO_SKIP=1 npm run test:e2e
scripts.ui:test:stack: source scripts/load-test-env.sh && cd packages/ui && RUN_DOCKER_STACK_TESTS=1 npm run test:e2e
scripts.wizard:dev: rm -rf /tmp/openpalm/.dev && OP_HOME=/tmp/openpalm/.dev OP_IMAGE_TAG=dev bun run packages/cli/src/main.ts install --no-start
scripts._dev:stack:note: Intentional dev shortcut: 4-file compose list mirrors the CLI overlay discovery for the dev layout — MANAGED core/services/portals from .dev/system/stack/, USER custom from .dev/config/stack/. --project-name openpalm-dev is required to avoid colliding with a production stack under ~/.openpalm/.
scripts.test: bun test --isolate --no-orphans packages/portal-discord packages/portal-slack packages/portal-sdk packages/cli/src packages/lib packages/guardian/ containers/assistant scripts/
